codex.ssc-extras.instincts_2: You sense that indulging your instincts further could make this transformation permanent. Refraining from them lets your instincts gradually subside.
info.ssc-extras.inhibitor_calmed_instinc: Your instinct eases. Your form remains unchanged.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.cursed: Binds itself to cursed wearers. Curses an uncursed wearer.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.release: Remove at permanent form, or use a Cleansing Key.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.infuse: Craft with a curse potion to infuse its form.

codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.ti: The curse has left its first marks on your skin. Beneath the scattered scales, your body still feels familiar.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.ap:
Your body has a human outline, with scattered brown and olive scales across your forehead, back and limbs. Small patches of pale scales mark the center of your chest and abdomen.
A short, blunt muzzle projects from your face beneath two small forehead horns.
A stubby tail sits at the base of your spine. Small, dark claws tip your fingers and toes, while your hands and feet retain their human shape.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.pr:
Your changing digestion draws as much nourishment from raw food as from their cooked versions.
With an empty main hand, your claws dig like wooden tools and deal 1 additional damage. Your emerging scales provide 1 point of natural armor.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.co: Your growing horns and tail prevent helmets and leggings from fitting your altered body.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.in:
You begin to crave raw food, and they seem appetizing. Each raw meal strengthens the urge to give in to the changes.
You begin to desire to dig the earth and strike your enemies with your claws.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_0.d: The curse has left its first marks on your skin. Beneath the scattered scales, your body still feels familiar.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.ti: The changes are becoming harder to conceal. Your growing frame carries a strength that your human body never had.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.ap:
You stand two blocks tall, with a broad frame and patches of scales across your shoulders, flanks and limbs. Pale scales run down your chest and belly, while darker patches cover your back. Skin remains visible between them.
Your head sits on an elongated neck, with a projecting muzzle and thick horns that curve backward above your brow.
Your broad hands and feet each bear three dark claws. Your fingers and thumbs can still close around a handle. A long, tapering tail balances your upright body.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.pr:
Your sturdier frame grants 1 additional heart, and your hardening scales provide 3 points of natural armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws deal 3 damage and dig with the speed and harvesting strength of stone tools.
Your stronger jaws let you eat 50% faster. Raw food nourish you as well as their cooked versions.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.co:
Helmets and leggings cannot accommodate your horns and tail. Your broad, clawed feet have also outgrown boots.
Your heavy body reduces your swimming speed by 15%.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.in:
Waiting for food to cook feels increasingly unnecessary. Raw food tempt you to eat them as they are.
Indulging that appetite strengthens your draconic instincts.
You begin to desire to dig the earth and strike your enemies with your claws.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_1.d: The changes are becoming harder to conceal. Your growing frame carries a strength that your human body never had.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.ti: Standing upright takes an unfamiliar effort. Whenever you break into a run, your body knows another way to move.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.ap:
Most of your body is covered in earthy scales, with pale plates along your throat, chest and abdomen. A sloping neck carries your heavy head forward, beneath swept horns and a broad muzzle.
Your slightly forward-leaning frame stands 2.2 blocks tall. Digitigrade hind legs rest on broad, clawed toes, with raised heels and a thick tail extending behind your hips.
Each forepaw has three thick, clawed digits and pads underneath, with no thumb. You stand with your torso leaning slightly forward and drop onto all fours to run or sneak.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.pr:
Your powerful build grants 4 additional hearts and 50% knockback resistance. Thick scales provide 15 points of natural armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws dig like iron tools and strike with the base damage of an iron sword (6). Your strength increases all melee damage by 25%.
Running on all fours increases your sprinting speed by 20%.
You eat twice as fast. Raw food nourish you as well as their cooked versions.
With a saddle, you can transport humanoid mobs.
If you let a pillager ride you, they will fight for you.
Your paw pads reduce fall damage by 50%.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.co:
Your altered proportions no longer fit any armor. Without a thumb, you carry items in your mouth, but tools and weapons slip free when you try to dig or strike with them. You cannot operate tools or weapons.
When hunger falls to 3 or less, you can no longer maintain your upright stance and must walk on all fours until you have eaten enough.
Pillagers may see you as a potential mount. Try to avoid them if you don't want to become one.
Your heavy body reduces your swimming speed by 25%.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.in:
Waiting for food to cook feels increasingly unnecessary. Raw food tempt you to eat them as they are.
Indulging that appetite strengthens your draconic instincts.
You begin to desire to dig the earth and strike your enemies with your claws.
Moving on all fours exhilarates you and strengthens your draconic instincts. The longer you stay low, the more comfortable it feels.
Carrying a rider keeps you on all fours may make you forget how to stand upright.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_2.d: Standing upright takes an unfamiliar effort. Whenever you break into a run, your body knows another way to move.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.ti: A broad, horned shape moves across the earth on four heavy paws. The drake you have become feels entirely at home in its own skin.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.ap:
You are a broad, low-bodied drake. Olive-brown scales cover your back and flanks, with pale, stone-colored plates along your throat, chest and belly. Your deep torso rests between powerful shoulders and muscular haunches.
A thick, plated neck supports your heavy head. A blunt snout sits above a deep lower jaw; dark horns sweep back from your brow, with smaller spurs framing your cheeks.
Your four sturdy legs end in broad paws, each with three thick toes, firm pads and dark talons. Raised heels and angled joints support your quadrupedal stance. A heavy tail tapers behind you.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.pr:
Your fully developed body grants 6 additional hearts, followed by a 10% bonus increase to maximum health. Your heavy build provides 50% knockback resistance.
Your dense scales now reduce incoming damage by 75%, replacing the need for armor.
With an empty main hand, your claws dig like diamond tools and strike with the base damage of a diamond sword (7). Your strength increases all melee damage by another 50%.
Your four-footed stride increases normal movement speed by 30% and sprinting speed by 45%. You eat twice as fast, gaining cooked-food nourishment from raw food.
With a saddle, you can transport humanoid mobs.
Pillagers remain neutral, but may try to give you the missing riding equipment if you already wear part of the set. With a full set of cursed riding equipment, nearby pillagers will fight for you.
Primary ability — Body Slam: Rush forward up to 3 blocks, stopping on an enemy or obstacle. Sweep enemies in front for damage equal to your maximum health. Costs 1 drumstick (2 hunger points); 5-second cooldown.
Your paw pads reduce fall damage by 75%.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.co:
Your body can only move on all fours. Your bulkier build is too broad for passages only one block wide.
No armor fits your frame. You carry tools and weapons in your mouth, but they fall when used to dig or strike.
A riding pillager may control your movement through cursed reins when pursuing a foe.
Your heavy body reduces your swimming speed by 35%.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_3.d: A broad, horned shape moves across the earth on four heavy paws. The drake you have become feels entirely at home in its own skin.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.st:
A prickling sensation spreads across your forehead and down your back. When you reach for it, patches of skin stiffen beneath your fingers and divide into small, hard scales. More patches surface along your arms and shins, while paler scales press through the skin of your chest and abdomen.
Pressure gathers around your nose and mouth. They push forward together, drawing your jaw into a short muzzle. Two tender spots above your brow swell, then harden into little horns.
A tug at the base of your spine makes you shift your weight. Something presses outward, lengthening into a stubby tail. You turn to look and feel it move with your hips, a new limb you have not yet learned to control.
Your fingertips and toes tingle as the nails darken and thicken into small claws. You flex them against your palms, feeling their hard points where your nails used to be.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.st:
The skin around your existing scales begins to tighten. New rows spread outward, joining the isolated patches across your shoulders, sides and limbs. The pale scales on your abdomen broaden toward your chest as your torso fills out beneath them.
A deep stretch travels through your legs and back, lifting your eye level as your frame grows taller. Your neck lengthens, easing your head forward; your jaw follows as the muzzle pushes farther from your face. The small horns above your brow thicken and curve backward.
Your hands and feet feel crowded as they broaden around growing claws. The short points lengthen into sturdy talons, forcing your fingers and toes farther apart. You curl your fingers experimentally and find that your thumbs can still meet them.
Your tail pulls at the base of your spine, extending section by section. Muscles tighten along its length, and it swings behind you as you lean forward, helping you recover your balance.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.st:
The remaining gaps between your scales narrow as hardened skin spreads over your body. Pale plates knit together along your throat and belly. Your neck thickens and slopes forward, drawing your head and shoulders into a slight forward lean as your muzzle and horns grow heavier.
Your calves tighten sharply. Your heels lift, and your feet lengthen beneath you until your weight shifts onto broad, clawed toes. Trying to stand as before sends you swaying; your tail thickens and extends behind your hips, countering the pull of your upper body.
You reach for support, but your thumbs are shortening against your palms. Your remaining fingers thicken into three clawed digits, while firm pads swell underneath. Closing your hands no longer makes a proper grip. You lower them to the ground and feel the pads take your weight.
Your shoulders settle between your forelimbs. When you move forward, all four limbs fall into step before you consciously arrange them. You push yourself back into a gently forward-leaning stance, but your next attempt to run brings your forepaws down again.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.st:
A deep pressure spreads through your chest and back, drawing you down onto all fours. Your shoulders broaden, your ribs expand, and your torso stretches between forelegs and hind legs. The weight that once rested over your hips settles across all four limbs.
Your arms thicken into forelegs as the wrists and elbows shift to support you. Pads spread beneath the three toes of each paw, and the claws lengthen into heavy talons. Your hindquarters fill out with muscle, holding the raised joints firmly above the ground.
Your neck swells beneath its plates. The muzzle pushes outward and widens, your lower jaw deepening beneath it. Your horns sweep farther back, and smaller spurs press out along your cheeks. Scales pack tightly across your growing body as the pale plates of your underside broaden.
Your tail grows heavier at the base and lengthens behind you. As the pressure eases, you shift your weight to rise, but your hips and spine no longer support an upright stance. You plant your forepaws again, then take your first steady steps in the completed body of a drake.
tooltip.ssc-extras.blinding_rein: Inflicts Drake Curse. Functions as Cursed Reins. Pillagers close the blinkers for battle and reopen them at the stable.
tooltip.ssc-extras.cursed_reins: Inflicts Drake Curse. A rider can steer a saddled permanent drake while giving movement input.
tooltip.ssc-extras.cursed_saddle: Inflicts Drake Curse. Allows other players to ride a permanent drake.
tooltip.ssc-extras.drake_mount_set_bonus: Set bonus: Wearing both pieces binds them and makes you loyal to the pillager faction.
tooltip.ssc-extras.riders_chest: 54 shared slots. Sneak-use the drake, press inventory while riding, or use your SSC secondary ability.
tooltip.ssc-extras.drake_chest_requireme: Fits permanent drake players and natural drakes.
tooltip.ssc-extras.netherite_claw_tips: Netherite empty-hand tools and claws. Accepts tool and sword enchantments.
tooltip.ssc-extras.drake_pillager_rider: Stage 2+: sneak-use a pillager to carry it; sneak again to cancel.
tooltip.ssc-extras.cleansing_key.cleanse: Curse Cleansed for 30s: stops cursed items equipping themselves.
tooltip.ssc-extras.cleansing_key.release: Drops worn cursed collars, reins and saddles. Costs 1 use per item.
tooltip.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.suppress: Blocks instinct gain, spending 1 durability per instinct blocked.
tooltip.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.first: Also prevents buildup before the first transformation.
tooltip.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.durabilit: The instinct gauge outline shows remaining cuff durability.
tooltip.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.pair: Wear at wrists and ankles to halve wear on each pair.
message.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.weak: The magic within you surges. You feel the cuffs around your %s trembling and weakening.
message.ssc-extras.metal_cuffs.critical: The cuffs around your %s are about to break. Replace or repair them if you wish to keep your current form.
message.ssc-extras.drake.hunger_collapse: Your legs are shaking from exhaustion, and you fall down to all fours. You don't have enough energy to support your upright stance!
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager_equipp: A pillager has equipped you with %s.
message.ssc-extras.collar.auto_equipped: The cursed collar has fastened itself around your neck!
gamerule.CursedCollarAutoEquipForCursedP: Cursed collars in inventories or opened containers equip cursed players with empty neck slots. Permanent forms remain exempt.
gamerule.CursedCollarAutoEquipForUncurse: Cursed collars in inventories or opened containers equip uncursed players with empty neck slots.
gamerule.PillagerMountRecruitingForDrake: Pillagers equip drakes at every stage with missing cursed reins and saddles, and complete the equipment of those who are missing a piece.
gamerule.PillagerMountRecruitingForUncur: Pillagers equip uncursed players with cursed reins and saddles.
power.ssc-extras.drake/body_slam.name: Body Slam
power.ssc-extras.drake/body_slam.descrip: Rush forward up to 3 blocks, stopping on an enemy or obstacle. Sweep enemies in front for damage equal to your maximum health. Costs 1 drumstick (2 hunger points); 5-second cooldown.
message.ssc-extras.drake.roam_edge: You are getting close to the edge of the drake stable...
message.ssc-extras.drake.roam_outside: You have roamed outside your stable...
message.ssc-extras.drake.roam_spotted: A pillager just spotted you outside the range...
message.ssc-extras.drake.escape_marked: The pillagers think you are trying to escape...
message.ssc-extras.drake.taming_collar: After your repeated escapes, a pillager locks a cursed taming collar around your neck.
message.ssc-extras.drake.struggle_free: You struggle free of the leash!
message.ssc-extras.drake.battle_treat: A pillager rewards you with a treat after the battle.
tooltip.ssc-extras.taming_collar.restric: Keeps drakes on all fours. Prevents opening fence gates, breaking or placing blocks, and freely untying your leash.
message.ssc-extras.drake.last_escape_war: You sense that being caught after your next escape will bring punishment. This is your last chance.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.mount_: Pillager: %s, hold still. I'm getting on; we're guarding the outpost.
Pillager: %s, steady now. I'm getting on; we're making the rounds.
Pillager: %s, brace yourself. I'm mounting up; there's an enemy to fight.
Pillager: %s, hold still. I'm riding you back to your stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.battle: Pillager: %s, enemy ahead! Turn toward them and keep moving.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.escape: Pillager: %s! You're too far out. Stop there; you're coming back with us.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.range_: Pillager: %s, this way. Stay within the stable's range.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.escape: Pillager: Caught you, %s. This lead will keep you close. Back to your stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.recall: Pillager: Come along, %s. Follow the lead; it's time to return to the stable.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.stable: Pillager: %s, back where you belong. Stay tied here and settle down.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.feed: Pillager: Hungry, %s? Here. Eat your meat.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.hand_f: Pillager: Still not eating, %s? Open up. I'll feed you.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.cataly: Pillager: Open up, %s. This catalyst will help you become a proper drake.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.reward: Pillager: Good work, %s. You've earned this meat.
message.ssc-extras.drake.pillager.stable: Pillager: Listen carefully, %s. Stay within %s blocks of the stable. No escaping; we'll bring you back if you're caught. Be in your stall for the keeper's check after midnight. Those are the rules.
message.ssc-extras.drake.service_promise: You are now officially registered as a mount in the stable. The keepers promise a reward after ten days of good service: a ritual to make you their permanent mount. Service continues while you roam. A keeper checks your stall once after midnight; be there to keep the promise.
message.ssc-extras.drake.service_reset: A keeper checked after midnight and did not see you in your assigned stall. The promise is broken; the ten days of good service must begin again.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_soon: Eight days of good service. The keepers are preparing your reward: the permanent mount transformation. Soon your soul will be a drake, bound to this stall even beyond death.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_ready: Ten days of good service! Three keepers will come for you and lead you to your hay for the permanent mount ritual.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_gatherin: Three keepers are coming for you. They will leash you and take you to your assigned stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_held: Two keepers hold you firmly on the hay while the third prepares the binding chant.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_begin: The third keeper begins chanting. You struggle beneath falling runes as the other two hold you on the hay. The soulbinding ritual has begun.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_change: The chant drives your instincts higher, rapidly advancing your drake transformation.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_soul: The chant sinks deeper. Your soul is becoming the drake itself. You will be only respawned as a drake from now on.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_interrup: The ritual has been interrupted. Your service is remembered; the keepers will gather and begin again when they can.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_complete: Your soul is a drake now. With a drake's soul, you've forgotten how to stand upright. You are the stable's permanent mount. The Cursed Moon can no longer change your form. Your cursed equipment is Soulbound, and death will return you to your stall. You can no longer leave the range without a rider.
message.ssc-extras.drake.soul_respawn: Your drake soul returns to its assigned stall.
message.ssc-extras.drake.soul_freed: The drake transformation is completely undone. Your soul is free.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_due: Caught escaping this stable six times. The keepers will now perform the full feralization punishment ritual.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_gath: Three pillagers are coming to leash you to your stall. This time they intend to take away your human mind.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_feed: The leader feeds you a full beastization catalyst before each change of your soul, holding it to your mouth for three seconds.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_begi: The leader begins chanting while the other keepers hold you still. Your soul rises above your body, ready to be transformed.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_mind: Words and memories dissolve beneath the chant. Only your mount name and meat still mean anything. The leader feeds you five more catalysts, then keeps feeding until your body is a Feral Drake.
message.ssc-extras.drake.punishment_comp: The ritual is complete. Your drake mind knows only food, sleep, and its mount name.
message.ssc-extras.drake.feral_takeover: *Your drake instincts took over your body.*
tooltip.ssc-extras.iron_drake_shoes_hand: The iron shoes locks thumbs, can't carry items in the hands, and adds +5 empty-hand damage.
tooltip.ssc-extras.iron_drake_shoes_feet: The iron shoes reduce sprinting hunger consumption by 30%.
tooltip.ssc-extras.iron_drake_shoes_curs: Inflicts Drake Curse and Curse of Binding. Shod front paws cannot break, place or use blocks except hay, or use tools.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_warning: A keeper saw you tampering with the stable (%s/3). The third time, your paws will be fitted with cursed iron shoes.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_caught: A keeper caught you tampering with the stable for the third time. Your paws will be fitted with cursed iron shoes.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_gatheri: Three keepers gather: two to hold you, and one to fit the shoes. They lead you to the hay.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_held: They roll you onto your back on the hay. Two keepers hold you while the third raises a three-clawed iron shoe.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_paw_0: The keeper grips your first front limb and closes an iron shoe over its paw and thumb.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_paw_1: The keeper holds your other front limb and fits its shoe. Soon your mouth must carry what your paws cannot.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_paw_2: The keeper grips your first hind limb and fits an identical shoe on your paw.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_paw_3: The keeper holds your last hind limb while fitting its shoe. The binding curse seals all four iron shoes.
message.ssc-extras.drake.shoeing_complet: Your iron-shod paws cannot work blocks or tools; you can still sleep on hay. You now need to carry items in your mouth. Empty-paw strikes are stronger, and sprinting is more efficient now.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.no_sta: Cannot perform a ritual without an assigned stall.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.not_re: Cannot perform a ritual while dead or in Spectator mode.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.busy: A ritual or ride is already in progress.
message.ssc-extras.ritual_command.unavai: Your assigned stall is currently unavailable. Its hay and keepers are needed for the ritual.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_soul_ret: Your transformed drake soul returns to your body. The keepers begin sealing the bond.
message.ssc-extras.drake.bound_return: Your mount bond with this stable turns you back toward the stable's range.
message.ssc-extras.drake.ritual_feed: The keeper feeds you regular catalysts, holding each to your mouth for three seconds as your instincts surge.
